Numerical Second Derivatives of a Structure's Matrix

Source: R/numerical_fallbacks.R
numerical_d2matrix.Rd

One central difference of the analytic first derivatives where a structure supplies them, and a single mixed stencil on struct_matrix where it does not.

Usage

numerical_d2matrix(s, eta)

Arguments

s

A covstruct object.

eta

A numeric vector of free values.

Value

A named list of symmetric matrices, keyed as struct_pair_names(s).

Details

Differentiating the analytic first derivative costs one finite-difference layer rather than two, which is the rule the whole toolkit follows: never compose differences in the same variable. When the first derivatives are themselves numerical the two differences act on different components for an off-diagonal pair, so they commute into a four-point mixed stencil rather than compounding; the diagonal pairs use the three-point second-difference stencil directly, which is again one layer and not two.
